description:
Thank you to Snotgoblin terrain and thier Future proof terrai for sponsoring this episode!  These terrain sets are easy to assembly and can come pre painted ready to go.  https://futureproofterrain.com/. Its like lego, but for 40k!  

===============GAME INFO=============

A fun audience interactive game of 40k where the audience controls the orbital fleets raining down destruction upon the battlefield.  Will you help the beleaguered Imperium or join the Xenos Swarm!

The community Deathwatch comes out to face against a swarm of Tyranid monstrosities.  Who will take the field amid a rain of fire and death!
